jobs.title: Tech Product Manager - Agentic Platform
jobs.description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:   We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our Data Engineering team led by Victor Leroy , Senior Engineering Manager. Together, you'll be building the platform foundations that empower every Mirakl team to design, ship, and operate production-ready AI agents — fast, safely, and autonomously. We are open to both permanent and freelance candidates for this role. This role requires 4 days per week in the office and allows 1 day of remote work. Your Impact Build the Agentic Platform from the ground up : co-own the product vision and architecture with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers, delivering a self-service platform that lets Mirakl teams go from prototype to production at speed. Drive continuous discovery : engage internal teams to surface needs, qualify use cases, and identify the highest-priority pain points — turning insights into a focused, well-prioritised roadmap. Shape the roadmap and steer delivery : define short- and long-term priorities with the Engineering Manager, structure sprints, and own quarterly commitments to deliver incremental value with rigour and predictability. Champion quality in production : build the agent quality loop — offline evals integrated into CI/CD, online monitoring, annotation consoles — in partnership with product teams and domain experts. Track adoption and iterate : instrument usage metrics, run user testing, and collect feedback to continuously challenge and sharpen the product strategy against real-world signal.   What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 2 years on technical or platform products Proven track record of driving end-to-end product cycles: discovery, roadmap definition, engineering collaboration, and delivery Demonstrated ability to stay current in a fast-moving technology landscape and quickly adapt architectural choices accordingly Previous experience shipping LLM-based or agentic AI products to production is a strong plus Skills: Technical product management: requirements gathering, roadmap prioritisation, backlog management Agentic AI & GenAI systems: LLM orchestration, memory, tool calling / MCP, guardrails, evals, cost and latency management Cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams (AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers) Stakeholder management and communication — from engineering teams to senior leadership Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)   Tech Stack Experience with: LLM providers & gateways : Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter Data & ML platform : Databricks, Python, Kafka, PostgreSQL Agentic tooling : agent frameworks & runtimes, MCP, vector databases, LLM evals & tracing Infrastructure : Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, ArgoCD, Datadog Collaboration tools : FigJam, Jira, Slack, Google Workspace   Languages French : Fluent (C2 level required) English : Fluent (C2 level required)   Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. 40 min witch a Talent Acquisition 1 Hour interview with Hiring Managers 2 x STAR interviews Offer We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.  We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews . Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
